newsitem.title: HUNGARY: EBRD DEMANDS GOLDSUN PAY ITS ARREARS.
newsitem.headline: EBRD DEMANDS GOLDSUN PAY ITS ARREARS.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has demanded that Hungarian frozen food company Goldsun Hutoipari Rt repay immediately all its debts to the bank, amounting to 6.3 million marks, Goldsun said on Monday.
The demand follows the failure by Goldsun to fulfil its outstanding loan repayment obligation, by the agreed deadline, a company statement in the Budapest Stock Exchange's official gazette said.
Goldsun said it expected to conclude negotiations with the EBRD and a consortium of banks on the company's financial reorganisation next week.
Goldsun added that it did not foresee what the end result of the negotiations would be.
"No concrete agreement about the financial reorganisation has been concluded and the final result of the negotiations under way cannot be predicted," it said.
American Shamrock Capital Investors and Israel's Sunfrost Company hold 38.7 percent each in Goldsun, while 22.6 percent is held by small investors.
Goldsun had first-half losses of 365 million forints on net sales of 743 million forints in 1996.
Goldsun closed at 210 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday.
